description: Hong Kong horse racing meeting at Sha Tin or Happy Valley: every race with post time, class, distance, course, status, the AI top pick and, after the race, the first three. Without a date it returns the next upcoming meeting (or the latest one if none is scheduled).

lang.description: Output language: en (English) or zh (Traditional Chinese). Horse and people names are given in both where available.

venue.description: Sha Tin or Happy Valley: 'sha-tin' / 'ST' / '沙田' or 'happy-valley' / 'HV' / '跑馬地'

name: get_meeting
title: Race meeting overview
